Content.missing_package: The Phobos' War Has Been Declared mod folder is not enabled in the game's mod list.

Config.enabled: Record parts destroyed in battle and lay build sites for them afterwards.
Config.quiet: Minutes of game time without a hit, a hostile lock or your own weapons lock before battle stations end on their own. A Battle stations order holds until you stand down.
Config.damage: Hull damage from any cause (weapons, collisions, explosions) starts battle stations. Off: only hostile locks, your own weapons lock or your Battle stations order do.
Config.lay_during: Lay build sites while the fight is still on. Off: wait until you stand down, so crew are not sent into open breaches under fire.
Config.schematic: Which rebuild schematic decides what gets a build site: safe, safe-walls, everything, hull-only, or the name of your own file in BepInEx/config/PhobosWarDeclared/schematics.
Order.BattleStations.title: Battle stations
Order.BattleStations.action: [us] calls the crew to battle stations.
Order.BattleStations.tooltip: Start recording destroyed parts on this ship until you stand down, even before the first shot.
Order.StandDown.title: Stand down
Order.StandDown.tooltip: End battle stations now and lay build sites for what was destroyed, as the rebuild schematic allows.
Order.LayHeld.title: Lay held build sites
Order.LayHeld.tooltip: Lay build sites for every held part now, walls and doors included. Unbuilt walls and machines block walking until the crew finish them.
